text:
In February, we got the first B1. In August, they gave me the B1 until I get the confirmation for the A5 because I need it for work. She even said not to get the inter-visa because it's not worth it, a thing that made us believe that we'll get the A5 answer in useful time. On Wednesday, we sent an email to ask for an appointment for an inter-visa on my current B1 and also asked about the whole situation, and we got the answer that I posted last time. Yesterday, we asked what the meeting in December is for, and she said that it is for the A5 and I will stay on B1 until then, and for my son, she still doesn't have an answer. She did some phone calls to check, but nothing is clear. We started the process married. My son is 13 now.
I have full custody and a parental consent letter from my ex-husband. The letter states he agrees that our son can relocate with me to Israel, but they ask to also state that he agrees to Israeli citizenship. My son is 13 now
